title: Applied AI Engineering & Systems
description: Comprehensive 5-day curriculum covering embeddings, RAG architectures, LLM agents, system scaling, and AI evaluation.

topics.name: Vector Spaces & Similarity Metrics
topics.description: High-dimensional embedding representations, Cosine similarity, Dot product, Euclidean distance.
learning_objectives: Explain how text tokens map to dense vector representations
Compare cosine similarity versus dot product for normalized vectors
Identify high-dimensionality distance trade-offs (curse of dimensionality)

topics.name: Vector Indexing & HNSW
topics.description: Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) search algorithms, Hierarchical Navigable Small World graphs.
learning_objectives: Differentiate between exact k-NN and approximate ANN search
Explain graph construction in HNSW indexing

topics.name: Document Chunking & Hybrid Retrieval
topics.description: Chunking strategies (semantic, recursive), Hybrid search (BM25 lexical + Dense vector), Reciprocal Rank Fusion.
learning_objectives: Analyze document chunk size impact on retrieval context window
Formulate hybrid retrieval strategies combining BM25 with vector search

topics.name: RAG Hallucination & Reranking
topics.description: Cross-encoder reranking, Groundedness verification, Query transformation.
learning_objectives: Identify common RAG failure modes (retrieval failure vs generator hallucination)

modules.title: Module 3: Autonomous AI Agents & Tool Use

topics.name: Structured Output & Function Calling
topics.description: JSON schema enforcement, tool declaration, argument validation.
learning_objectives: Design robust Pydantic schemas for LLM function calling
Handle API rate limits and schema parsing exceptions gracefully

topics.name: ReAct Loop & Multi-Agent Communication
topics.description: Reasoning + Acting loops, state persistence, subagent delegation.
learning_objectives: Implement stateful execution loops for autonomous agent steps
Design guardrails to prevent infinite tool loops

modules.title: Module 4: System Architecture & Vector DB Scaling

topics.name: PostgreSQL + pgvector vs Specialized Vector DBs
topics.description: Index maintenance, memory footprint, IVFFlat vs HNSW, sharding.
learning_objectives: Evaluate operational complexity of pgvector vs dedicated vector databases
Calculate RAM requirements for high-dimensional vector caching

topics.name: LLM As A Judge & Metric Benchmarks
topics.description: Faithfulness, Answer Relevance, Semantic similarity benchmarks, Prompt Injection defense.
learning_objectives: Construct automated test suites using LLM-as-a-judge patterns
Mitigate prompt injection and jailbreak vulnerabilities
